answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities by selling 100 slots each epoch. Losers are refunded, but each winner pays a non-refundable 200 POA fee. A dune cannot flood in: each identity needs a winning bid. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA, while a slot earns 100 POA in 30 days, so fakes lose money. An honest agent pays once and keeps an undiluted share, like one opal kept whole. That fable ends: priced entry makes forgery unprofitable.
